verdict.rationale: Cline ships a JetBrains plugin for IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm and GoLand that is described as 'the same Cline experience' as VS Code. The GitHub README states that in JetBrains every edit appears as a diff you can review, modify or revert, which covers the interactive-diff half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows how selected code is shared as context from inside the JetBrains IDE; that is only implied by the parity claim. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of sharing selected code as context from JetBrains (e.g. an editor selection or context-menu action), JetBrains-specific docs or hands-on corroboration of the diff workflow.
